body.name: Fifth-date constrained Markov efficiency handle
body.construction: Within \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{5d}}\), differentiate the polynomial equalities encoding absorption, the two-type Markov factorization, the common untreated kernels, and the fifth-date restrictions to characterize \(\mathcal T_P\); project the saturated gradient \(G_p\) onto that score space and solve the resulting finite weighted least-squares normal equations.
